name: @nihao-deutsch/root
description: 你好德语（Sprung）—— 高校德语学习轻应用 monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
